currencyNote: Listing and transaction fees are USD-denominated. Payment processing is charged in the seller's local currency.

transactionFee.appliesTo: total order amount including shipping and gift wrap charged to the buyer

paymentProcessingNote: Rate and fixed component vary by seller country. Only TR and US are verified here. Any additional country must be verified against Etsy Help before being added to the dropdown.

offsiteAds.condition: Shop has never made 10.000 USD in any consecutive 365-day period. Participation optional.
Shop has made 10.000 USD or more in a consecutive 365-day period. Participation mandatory.

correctionsToThirdPartyData: ikas.com/tr/etsy-komisyon-hesaplama states the Turkey payment processing fee is 4.5 percent + 0.30 USD. Etsy's own help documentation states 6.5 percent + 3 TRY. The ikas figure is wrong or stale and must NOT be used.
